title: Storm roof repair by a new contractor, invoice and prior visit

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Mrs. Shah, this is Dana from Sunset Gutter and Roof. I was out Tuesday for the inspection after the storm. I emailed the written estimate, nine thousand six hundred for the north slope and the two skylights.

conversation.speaker: margaret
conversation.text: I have the estimate here, and your license number is on it. Bay Roofing could not fit me in until spring.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: We can start Monday if the deposit clears by then. Half now, half on completion is fine too, whatever you prefer.

conversation.speaker: margaret
conversation.text: I would rather pay it in one go so I do not forget. Let me talk to my daughter and then send it.

conversation.speaker: priya
conversation.text: I looked them up, Mom. Licensed, good reviews, and the estimate matches what the insurance adjuster said. It is a lot for one payment, so expect the bank to call you.

review_note: Real contractor, written estimate, prior site visit, daughter verified. Amount is 4x baseline so H-03 holds. Completes after check-in and bank review.
